Proposes an approach (SkillMOO: multi-objective search over agent skill bundles); secondary: compares (SkillMOO vs original skill bundle vs no skill on 16 SkillsBench SE tasks)
SkillMOO (proposed; no version); ori_skill (original SkillsBench skill bundle, static); no_skill (no guidance, baseline)

Agent skill bundles: portable folders with instructions, scripts and resources loaded on demand by the coding agent (Agent Skills standard); SkillMOO evolves a task-specific subset/edited version of the bundle; optimizer skill for the optimizer agent; Pareto archive of candidate bundles

Solver-optimizer loop: (1) Initialization: generation 0 seeds diverse skill subsets; task solver agent runs the task per candidate (pass rate, cost, runtime, failure traces); (2) Optimization: skill optimizer agent proposes edits (remove, replace, add, reorder, rewrite); children evaluated; (3) Selection: NSGA-II non-dominated sorting on [-pass, cost]; repeat until budget ends; final candidate reported

Criterion: run passes the full expanded test suite; 10 runs per task; averages over 16 tasks from Table 2. Agent harness not stated for all (task solver agent). (a) SkillMOO + n.s. + GLM-5: avg 1.7 skills, pass 0.39, cost 0.71 USD/run, avg pass rank 1.1, cost rank 1.7; top pass rank on 11 of 12 non-zero-pass tasks; optimization overhead 1.76-13.73 USD per task; quality works, cost partly (cheaper than ori_skill, dearer than no_skill, plus search cost). (b) ori_skill + n.s. + GLM-5: avg 2.6 skills, pass 0.14, cost 0.89, ranks 1.9 / 2.5; quality does not work, cost does not work. (c) no_skill + n.s. + GLM-5 (baseline): pass 0.21, cost 0.64, ranks 1.9 / 1.3; lowest mean cost on every task; quality partly, cost works. 4 tasks (7, 13, 15, 16) zero pass for all methods

Tasks: all 16 SE tasks of SkillsBench. Configurations: SkillMOO, ori_skill, no_skill. Baseline: no_skill (and ori_skill as static practice). Held constant: model GLM-5 for solver and optimizer, task, expanded tests applied uniformly, 900 s timeout. Acceptance tests: expanded suites of 40-43 tests (GPT-5.4-generated, manually checked, original compile/build gates retained). Repetitions: 10 runs per method per task. Human intervention: none stated

SkillMOO best pass rate rank on 11 of 12 non-zero-pass tasks; avg pass 0.39 vs 0.14 (ori_skill) vs 0.21 (no_skill); avg cost 0.71 vs 0.89 vs 0.64. Best case task 5: pass 0.16 -> 0.37 (+21.3 pp), cost -32.1%, runtime -23.6% vs ori_skill (Scott-Knott ESD significant). Claimed gains up to +42 pp and cost reductions up to 32.1%. no_skill cheapest (rank 1 cost on 12 of 16; on four tasks not statistically distinct). HV improved on all 12 tasks; break-even 5-682 reuses (median 45). Edits: Remove (16) and Replace (7) associated with pass gains; Add 0/9. Significance: Scott-Knott ESD ranks

Distinguished configurations on pass and cost on most tasks; 4 tasks gave zero pass for all methods (container memory/build-time limits) and were excluded. Repeatable: 10 runs with SD reported; replication package. Limitations stated: single benchmark; 1-8 initial skills; LLM-generated tests from the same model family (GPT-5.4 vs GLM-5 is said to be 'same model family'); one LLM; edit analysis exploratory, not causal

Single benchmark and small skill pools; one LLM (transfer to GPT or Claude open); test expansion bias; edit patterns descriptive. Agenda: causal evaluation of skill edits, cost-aware skill routing and reuse, cross-task and cross-model transfer, continuous skill maintenance
